result.title: Bayesian Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with Abstention
result.summary: We study the Bayesian fixed-confidence best-arm identification problem in which a learner can abstain from making a terminal recommendation. Subject to a target error probability $δ$ and an abstention budget $α$, we propose Screen-and-Confirm (S&C) and analyze its expected stopping time. We further derive the minimum expected stopping time for any algorithm that satisfies these constraints. For Gaussian priors and rewards, as $(δ,α)\downarrow(0,0)$, we establish matching upper and lower bounds up to multiplicative constants, with rate $κ_ν^2[1+\log((α+δ)/δ)]/(α+δ)$, where $κ_ν$ is the prior density of the top-two gap at zero, highlighting that nearly tied instances govern the sampling cost. When abstention is disallowed ($α=0$), S&C yields the optimal $Θ(1/δ)$ dependence for fixed model parameters, removing the additional $\log(1/δ)$ factor in the upper bound of Jang et al. (2024) under our Gaussian assumptions. We further characterize the exact multiplicative constant of the minimum expected stopping time for practical regimes including (i) fixed $α\in (0,1)$ and (ii) $α/δ\to\infty$, which are also achieved by S&C.

AI.brief_summary: 研究允许弃权（abstention）的贝叶斯固定置信度最佳臂识别问题，提出 Screen-and-Confirm 算法并刻画其期望停止时间，进一步给出在误差概率 δ 与弃权预算 α 约束下任意算法的最小期望停止时间上下界；在高斯先验与奖励、δ、α 趋于零时得到可达的匹配速率，并说明近乎并列的实例主导采样成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 弃权预算与误差约束下的最优停止时间下界，可能为 LVR 中「何时停止取视觉证据、何时弃答」的 STOP 决策及计算—错误权衡提供理论参照，但该结果建立在 bandit 先验与独立采样假设上，能否映射到多模态证据筛选尚待核查。
